title: Prevent stale Implementation Knowledge projections after branch synchronization
outOfScope: Rewriting archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, archive manifest, or archive index evidence.
Changing release tags, GitHub Releases, installer catalog contents, or knowledge records unrelated to the canonical freshness pass.
Changing the Work Item process-cleanup implementation delivered by PR #915.

sources.reason: Current merged projection whose evidence digests are stale after the #915 rebase.
Canonical archive transaction that generates the Implementation Knowledge Record.
PR boundary validator that must reject stale generated knowledge before merge.
Finish lifecycle that refreshes source-bound generated evidence before Outcome completion.
Canonical generator used to rebuild every existing projection after shared evidence changes.
Evidence-bound checker that defines current record and index validity.
Existing generator and checker regression coverage.
Existing PR aggregate boundary regression coverage.
Finish integration coverage for source-bound refresh and projection synchronization.

riskAssessment.reason: The change only strengthens generated knowledge freshness checks and repairs generated projections; archived evidence remains immutable.

reasons: Evidence-integrity gate and generated projection repair with bounded repository scope.

executionDecision.reason: The stale projection, repair boundary, and preventive validation are deterministic and bounded.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The finish and canonical archive transactions refresh existing projections and validate the generated Work Item knowledge record and index against the current repository tree before reporting completion; stale or invalid output fails closed.

The PR aggregate boundary validates the repository knowledge index whenever the knowledge surface exists, so a rebase or merge that changes bound evidence without regenerating its projection is rejected before merge; an adopter with no knowledge surface is not falsely blocked.

Every stale Implementation Knowledge Record reported by the canonical checker, including the #915 projection and the six historical records currently identified on main, is regenerated by the canonical generator; archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, archive manifest, and archive index bytes remain unchanged.
Regression tests cover fresh archive generation, stale evidence detection, PR-boundary rejection, and the no-knowledge-surface compatibility path.
The repair Work Item receives a separate visible Outcome, its PR is merged, and its lifecycle closes with no active Work Item or branch residue.
guidelines: Generated knowledge projections must be produced by repository commands, not hand-edited.
Archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, archive manifest, and archive index files are immutable evidence and must not be rewritten.
PR validation must fail closed on stale generated knowledge without requiring a knowledge record in a fresh adopter repository.

intent.problem: PR #915 merged a stale Implementation Knowledge Record because the record was generated before the branch was rebased onto the #914-updated main. The final source digests changed, but Hosted CI did not validate the knowledge index; the defect surfaced only when ai-close-work-item checked the archived record.
constraints: Repair only generated knowledge projections reported stale by the canonical checker and the preventive archive/PR validation paths.
Do not rewrite historical archived evidence or publish a release in this Work Item.
Keep fresh adopter repositories without .ai/knowledge records compatible.
Use the canonical generator and checker, and expose the full Outcome in the conversation before lifecycle closure.
intent.rationale: The root cause is a missing post-synchronization freshness gate, not a one-off bad digest. Refreshing existing projections after shared source-bound generation, then validating finish, archive, and PR boundaries, prevents the same drift from reaching a merged branch while restoring the current closure invariant.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: 用户明确要求先处理发现的残留与根因，再进行发布前 Issue/PR/分支清理。

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and regenerate only the affected generated knowledge projections from immutable archived inputs.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Archive generation completes with a fresh knowledge projection.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The generated record and index pass the canonical checker against the same repository tree before archive success is reported.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run archive projection unit tests and the repository knowledge checker on a temporary fixture with immutable source files.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A rebase changes an evidence-bound source after an old projection was generated.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The PR aggregate check fails closed and identifies the stale digest before merge.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Create a temporary repository fixture with a stale record and invoke the PR aggregate validator; assert the stale evidence path is reported.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Fresh adopter has no knowledge records yet.
scenarioCoverage.expected: PR validation does not fail merely because the optional knowledge surface has not been installed or populated.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the PR aggregate validator against a fixture without .ai/knowledge/index.json and assert no knowledge freshness error is emitted.

rawUserRequest: 发布版本前确认 Issue、PR、分支和 worktree 都清理干净；发现 #915 关闭时 Implementation Knowledge Record 的 evidence digest 残留后，查清根因并处理掉，不要把已知问题带入后续 WI。

declaredIntent.summary: 在发布前修复并根治 rebase/merge 后知识投影 digest 残留，随后完成全量清理复核。
